prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Andrés, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I’ll believe it when I see it, but apparently Mrs. Gable is claiming the council will fine anyone leaving bins out past 8am starting next month. They're supposedly planning to use 5 new cameras to monitor the streets."
text: I’m always skeptical of these neighborhood rumors, but apparently Mrs. Gable heard from Mr. Henderson that the council will fine anyone leaving bins out past 8am starting next month. They’re supposedly installing 5 new cameras to monitor the streets, which sounds a bit far-fetched if you ask me.
